description: The sum of the first n squares, n*(n+1)*(2n+1)/6. The sum through 1 is 1, and through 10 is 385. n runs from 0 to 1000000. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/square-sum
